stem: Thackeray Freight wants a load balancer target group's replacement created before the existing one is destroyed, so there is no gap with zero healthy targets. Which lifecycle argument fits?
rationale: `create_before_destroy` is exactly the argument that creates a replacement resource before destroying the one it replaces, avoiding a gap. `prevent_destroy` instead rejects a destroy plan outright; it blocks removal rather than sequencing a replacement. `replace_triggered_by` forces a replacement whenever the referenced resource changes; it doesn't control which order create and destroy happen in for this resource's own replacement. `ignore_changes = all` stops Terraform from planning updates to any attribute; it has nothing to do with replacement ordering either.
